integrity: A standalone Python 3 standard-library checker performs exact integer computations and is embedded with the proof. The all-length result depends on the mathematical proof, not finite testing.
scientific_limitations: The Fourier-zero multiplicity at divisible-by-three lengths is bounded below but not exactly classified. Generalizations beyond simple cycles and sharp endpoint pseudoinverse norms are not established; historical-priority search is bounded.
title: Cycle independent sets: a modulo-three Fourier invertibility law with sharp spectral gaps
